title: APES CIC staff string extraction
summary: APES CIC hub, Cases, Tickets, Consultations, and staff Recruitment manage screens now come from UK English lang files and plugin namespaces. Glossary Roles / Applications labels are used on staff Recruitment nav.
changes: Move APES CIC and service-hub chrome into lang/en_GB/apes_cic.php.
Move Cases, Tickets, and Consultations UI, flashes, and validation messages into plugin ui lang files.
Move staff Recruitment manage Roles and Applications copy into recruitment::staff.*; keep glossary terms for nav labels.
Clear APES CIC staff and related plugin hard-coded inventory sections to 0.
affected_areas: APES CIC and organisation service hubs
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.38.x Language line: staff/plugin extraction after public-area extract (0.38.6).
validation: PHPUnit LocalisationStaffExtractionTest, recruitment manage/dual-frontend, Cases/Tickets/Consultations workflows.
php artisan lang:inventory — APES CIC staff and related plugin sections count 0.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: lang:check remains report-only until Wave 4 (#276 hard-fail).
SEO titles and Admin search keywords remain Wave 3.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Staff UI returns to prior hard-coded English if lang keys are removed; no database migrations are included.
